known_issues.description: analyse-speech/index.ts and generate-script/index.ts use model 'claude-opus-4-7' which does not exist. Must change to 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.
OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.local starts with 'ysk-proj-' instead of 'sk-proj-'. Transcription will fail. User must regenerate their OpenAI key.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_PRICE_MONTHLY, STRIPE_PRICE_ANNUAL, APP_URL not set. Must be added as Supabase Edge Function secrets.
ForgotPassword sends email with link to /reset-password but no such route or page exists.
SignUp.tsx links to /terms and /privacy but neither route exists.
Free users should be blocked after 3 sessions but no count check exists in TeleprompterSession.tsx before recording starts.
Stripe returns to /dashboard?upgraded=1 but Dashboard.tsx doesn't read this query param.
TeleprompterSession always navigates to /studio/debrief even for debate sessions. Should go to /debate/debrief for debate mode.
PDF Export button in Debrief.tsx has onClick={() => {}} — no implementation.
Delete Account confirm button in Profile.tsx has onClick={() => {}} — no implementation.
Audio blob is transcribed then discarded. Never uploaded to Supabase Storage. Pro 'audio replay' feature has no backing data.
Dashboard.tsx streak is hardcoded to 3. Must calculate from session dates.
Transcript is stored in sessions table but never displayed in Debrief.tsx.
All prompts and debate topics visible to free users. Should show only 3 prompts and 2 debate topics.
Analytics.tsx shows Pro gate if sessions.length > 1 but should be >= 3 to match paywall logic.
SignIn.tsx navigate() reads stale profile from store before new session profile is fetched.

notes: Session 1 complete. Full audit done. 16 issues found — 3 critical user-action items (env keys), 4 critical code fixes. Begin with fix #1 (Claude model IDs) — 2 line changes that unblock all AI functionality.
